name: Maruti Suzuki India
about: Maruti Suzuki India Ltd. is the leading automobile manufacturer in India, renowned for its affordable and fuel-efficient cars. The company offers a diverse range of vehicles, including hatchbacks, sedans, SUVs, and electric vehicles, catering to the needs of Indian consumers. Maruti Suzuki dominates the passenger vehicle market and has a strong reputation for reliability, innovation, and safety. Its popular models, such as Alto, Swift, and Baleno, have become household names. The company also focuses on sustainability, launching electric and hybrid vehicles. With an extensive dealer network and a growing presence in international markets, Maruti Suzuki continues to lead India’s automotive industry.
